carrier: six-dim vector scout semantics ported to matched 16-DOF budget: tanh latent, linear layers, MSE (historical control, this lane only)
charges: field: R (real vector latent, 16 DOF belief state)
quadratic_form/pairing: Euclidean inner product (readout + ray-metric scoring only, not a charged geometric structure of the carrier)
loss: coordinate MSE — historical-control exemption, card lane 1 only

belief_persistence_holevo.measurement: unit-normalized belief vectors -> rho_o = mean_v u u^T per test object; chi = S(mean rho) - mean S(rho_o), log2; null = object labels permuted over the 96 test latents

latent_cluster_ari.measurement: KMeans k=16 on 96 test beliefs; ARI vs object ids; null = 200 object-id shuffles against same clustering

P1_sign_lift.reason: real tanh vector latent charges no phase, no sign double cover, no connection; card sign law requires coherent paths + connection + interference/holonomy witness, none of which exist on this carrier — recorded as a scored fact of the control lane

P2_chirality.measurement: linear least-squares probe on final beliefs; train n=23, test n=10 objects with mirror-pair rules (2, 3); balanced accuracy

P3_order_witness.measurement: mean (1 - cos^2) between final beliefs for view order (...,2,3,...) vs (...,3,2,...); inputs keep their own view one-hots so only feeding order differs

P4_bracket_witness.measurement: max |((T.T).T)b - (T.(T.T))b| over 96 test beliefs; the carrier charges no bracket — composition is function composition, associative by construction

P5_occluded_belief.measurement: causal belief over views 0..v; sign(decode) at withheld cells of test objects vs CA-solved ground truth; chance ~0.5

P6_counterfactual_binding.measurement: for each test (obj, v<5): imagined action-advanced belief (T then belief_step) vs static belief, both decoded against view v+1 VISIBLE bits; score = win rate + 0.5*ties; 0.5 = action adds nothing

P7_reachability.measurement: predicted next embedding vs {true successor + 5 maximally visible-pattern-similar decoy views of OTHER objects}; top-1 by ray distance; chance ~0.167 — similarity-only carriers get fooled by lookalike unreachable views

P8_cross_view_persistence.measurement: nearest-neighbour (|cos|) among the 96 test beliefs, self excluded; hit = same object; chance = 5/95 ~ 0.053

P9_shock_recovery.measurement: flip all visible bits of view 2 (shock); divergence d_v = 1-cos^2 vs clean belief; recovery = (d_2-d_5)/d_2 clipped to [0,1], mean over test objects

P10_gauge_invariance.measurement: cyclic position rotation is an exact symmetry of the periodic additive CA; score = mean sign-prediction equivariance over k=1..7 rotations, test objects, all views/positions; the carrier charges no equivariance

leak_check_occluded_bits_never_in_featur.measurement: features rebuilt with random garbage in all withheld cells; torch.equal on the two feature tensors

shuffled_object_ids.note: training uses no object-id labels; shuffle control applied at scoring

ca_solve_unique_survivors.note: scoring-only ground truth; matches world_source joint_identifiability (64/64 exact)

findings: occluded-bit test accuracy 0.5199 (train 0.5637, chance ~0.5) over 277 withheld test bits
belief persistence: Holevo chi 1.2649 bits vs permutation-null q95 1.3213 -> above_null=False, margin -0.0564 bits
latent clusters: ARI 0.0113 vs shuffled-null mean -0.0009
ray-loss (metric only, MSE-trained control): train 0.6371 / test 0.7759
P1 not_applicable_for_this_carrier (no phase/connection charged); P4 deviation exactly 0 (no bracket charged, associative by construction)
control lane: vector scout sets the floor the geometric carriers must beat under identical budgets; promotion_allowed false
